statement: Producer checks for the production binary subtract-binary-batch oracle pass five targeted controls: 12900 first-witness comparisons against general pair enumeration; 880 comparisons at degrees 11,17,31 with preparation reuse; 90 OpenSSL-backed full-point comparisons; whole-pipeline known-answer recovery; and failure/extra-lane accounting controls. The audit uses the actual suite library and native kernels. The getrandom 0.4 fill API build prerequisite passes 64 dependency unit tests. New canonical test wiring and broader suites remain separately tracked; no timed speedup or independent signed verification is claimed.
